_readme: Screening rules for scripts/linkbuilding.py. Built from four paid guest-post vendor sheets reviewed on 2026-10-17. Entries are judged on what the sheets themselves show (domain name, sample post topic, repeated metrics), not on a crawl of each site. Re-check a domain before relying on a rejection that matters.
